cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Don’t Go
cards.instruction: Create reasons another player must stay with you. Never directly ask them to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before you zip your suitcase, let me wrap that jar of jam.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's already wrapped in my jumper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. That's your train jumper. We'll need to unpack it and find something else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you haven't tasted it. I'll get a spoon before you decide.

relationship.evidence: B2 has a packing solution and B4 abandons the gift to leave, credibly resisting delay.

heightening.evidence: B4 removes the packing obstacle; A5 invents a relevant tasting reason but does not use rank to secure it.

specificity.evidence: A1 suitcase and jam, B2 jumper establish a concrete departure task.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 stock phrase creates stiffness; the final taste is responsive but functions as a single-card ending.
